tools.name: keep_or_kill
tools.description: Should I keep, pause or kill this Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad? Give what one sale leaves the store before ad costs, what the ad has spent, and how many sales it brought. Returns keep, kill or too early, money up or down so far, the chance it really makes money, and the next step.

tools.name: find_where_ad_breaks
tools.description: Why isn't my Meta ad selling? Give the last 7 days of impressions, link clicks, purchases and amount spent from Ads Manager. Returns whether it breaks before the click, after the click or on price, compared with Triple Whale benchmarks from 40,000+ ecommerce brands, and what to fix first.

tools.name: plan_ad_test
tools.description: How many new Meta ads should I test, for how long, and should I use ABO or one ad set? Give the number of new ads, the budget a day and the usual cost per sale.
